tooltips.marketingStatus: Controls whether this contact may be included in marketing audiences. Unsubscribed contacts must not receive marketing messages.
tooltips.leadScore: An automation-calculated engagement and qualification score. It increases or decreases when configured scoring rules process customer activity.
tooltips.lastWebsiteVisitAt: The latest identified website visit received by Nexa tracking. Anonymous visits are not attached until the visitor can be matched to this contact.
tooltips.title: The contact's role or position at the selected primary account.
tooltips.targetLists: Static marketing and customer groups assigned to this contact. Dynamic segments will be managed by segmentation rules.
